title: Sitting in with Barney Bigard; not playing with Fats Navarro
summary: He sat in with Bigard, and was not with Goodman when Fats Navarro briefly played with him.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Did you ever play with Barney Bigard
I sat in with him, yes, sure.
He played beautiful things, yes. He had a beautiful style.
You were in the band with Goodman when Fats Navarro played in the band, the trumpet player?
You weren't in that edition of the Goodman band.
No. I think Lionel Hampton was with him then, wasn't he? The sextet, that is? Or quartet?
I don't remember. This was like in the
x Navarro only played with Goodman for a few days, including one recording session.
This is a guy who was a bebop trumpet player.
I know who you mean, but while I was with Benny, Fats wasn't on the scene then.
